description: Task heading and task tag parity between the Rust indexer (extract_tasks_and_headings and parse_task_metadata in src-tauri/src/vault/parsing.rs, through NoteEntry::from_content) and the e2e mock parser (parseTasks in e2e/mocks/vault-index.ts).

Each case gives a note's content and the expected wire fields: taskHeadings (omitted when empty) and each task's text, lineNumber, heading (omitted before the first heading), metadata.description and metadata.tags. Both sides assert these exact values.
Task tags follow the note tag rule (scan_inline_tags): # at the text start or after whitespace, a letter or _ first, then letters, ASCII digits, _, - and /, trailing / not part of the tag.

cases.name: frontmatter comment and fenced lines are not headings
cases.content:
---
title: x
# comment
---
## A #to-list
- [ ] a task
### B
- [ ] b task
```
# not a heading
- [ ] fenced
```
## C
- [ ] c task

cases.name: a task before the first heading has no heading
a note without tasks records no headings
headings with no task under them stay listed
a tilde fence closes only on a tilde fence
task tags accept Unicode letters and nested slashes
a digit-first tag, a mid-word hash and a wikilink heading are not task tags
a trailing slash stays in the description and duplicate task tags are kept
task tags next to a due date
